title: Claude AI can review pull requests and ship fixes on its own now
raw_excerpt: Anthropic is launching some new Claude AI features to help software engineers ship code. As part of a new Claude Ship product being announced today, Claude now can review, fix, and approve pull requests. Engineers have already been able to take advantage of Claude's code review capabilities thanks to the Code Review feature, which was announced in March and became generally available in October . What's new alongside Claude Ship are the PR Steward and Claude Approvals agents, which are launching in beta today. PR Steward "jumps in on failing CI checks, merge conflicts, and review feedback from Code Review, other review tools, or team member … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: Anthropic 推出 Claude Ship 产品，让 Claude 能自主审查、修复并批准 pull request，同时上线 PR Steward 与 Claude Approvals 两个 beta 代理，可自动处理 CI 失败、合并冲突和评审反馈。这是 AI 编程代理从「写代码」迈向「管代码」的关键一步，直接切入软件交付流程的审批环节，对工程团队的工作方式影响深远。

title: AI R&D-Relevant Model Capabilities Are Improving Rapidly
raw_excerpt: Frontier AI models often match or beat skilled humans on well-defined coding and optimization tasks. The length of tasks they can complete doubles about every 3.6 months. METR says public evidence can't rule out a drastic speedup in AI research within the next couple of years.
summary: AI 评估机构 METR 更新其广受引用的「时间跨度」图表，发现模型能完成的任务时长约每 3.6 个月翻一倍，在定义明确的编码与优化任务上已匹敌甚至超过熟练人类；但新增开放式任务后显示，模型在需要判断力的任务上明显落后。报告称公开证据无法排除未来两年内 AI 研究出现剧烈加速的可能，是当前最值得关注的 AI 能力趋势数据。

title: Tencent Releases Hy4 With Multimodal Input and Million-Token Context
raw_excerpt: Tencent's open-weight Hy4 supports text, image, and video understanding with a 770-billion-parameter backbone activating 49 billion parameters per token. It combines million-token context, sparse attention, and a speculative-decoding drafter, targeting coding, computer use, finance, research, and long-running assistant workflows.
summary: 腾讯开源 Hy4 模型，采用 7700 亿参数骨干、每 token 激活 490 亿参数的 MoE 架构，支持文本、图像、视频多模态理解，并具备百万级 token 上下文、稀疏注意力与投机解码草稿器，面向编程、电脑操作、金融、科研和长时助手工作流。这是国内大厂在超长上下文多模态开源模型上的重要落子，直接对标国际一线开源模型。

title: GLM-5.4: Toward generalized coding with our first loop transformer
summary: 智谱发布 GLM-5.4，号称首个「循环 transformer」架构，主打通用化编程能力。该消息在 Hacker News 获得逾千点赞和近 370 条讨论，热度极高。循环 transformer 若真能在架构层面带来效率或推理深度的提升，将是继 MoE、稀疏注意力之后又一条值得追踪的技术路线，对开源编程模型格局也有直接影响。

title: Inkling 2 Mini
raw_excerpt: Thinking Machines released Inkling 2 Mini, a 26.4B-parameter open-weight model that does extra internal computation to reason more before it answers. It leads every open-weight model under 100B parameters on the DeepSWE coding benchmark.
summary: Thinking Machines 发布 Inkling 2 Mini，一个 26.4B 参数的开源权重模型，通过在回答前进行额外内部计算来增强推理。官方称其在 DeepSWE 编程基准上领先所有 100B 参数以下的开源模型。小参数、强推理、开源权重三者结合，对希望在本地或低成本环境部署高质量编程代理的团队具有直接吸引力。

title: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
raw_excerpt: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo, an open-source runtime for Linux. It helps teams protect running systems while they roll out patches.
summary: OpenAI 与思科联合推出 Shirudo，一个面向 Linux 的开源运行时，帮助团队在滚动部署补丁期间保护正在运行的系统。这是 OpenAI 少见的偏基础设施与安全方向的工程开源项目，显示出其在模型之外也在布局企业级运行时工具链，对关注 AI 公司如何切入系统安全与运维场景的读者有参考价值。

title: Finding faster quantum algorithms with agents and formal verification
raw_excerpt: Using agent teams and formal verification to improve quantum algorithms for fusion and chemistry.
summary: Google DeepMind 发文介绍如何用智能体团队结合形式化验证，改进面向核聚变与化学计算的量子算法。该方法让多个 agent 协作搜索算法，并用形式化工具校验正确性，把「AI 做科研」从生成候选推进到可验证产出。对关注 AI for Science 与量子计算交叉方向的研究者来说，这是一条方法论层面的新进展。

title: Oregon and Virginia sue SpaceX over Grok’s porn deepfakes
raw_excerpt: In separate but similar lawsuits filed on Monday, Oregon Attorney General Dan Rayfield and Virginia Attorney General Jay Jones accused SpaceX of violating state consumer protection laws by ignoring industry-standard safeguards and falsely promoting the safety of its X social media platform and Grok AI features. The complaint filed in Virginia accuses Musk of willfully ignoring growing concerns around AI-generated sexualized deepfakes, and "instead saw a market opportunity for more profits," describing the weak safeguards around Grok as "not a failure but a feature." "Time and again, xAI and X told consumers they were being protected from ab … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 俄勒冈州与弗吉尼亚州总检察长分别对 SpaceX 提起诉讼，指控其旗下 X 平台与 Grok 忽视行业标准安全防护、虚假宣传平台安全性，放任 AI 生成色情深度伪造内容。弗吉尼亚诉状称弱防护「不是失败而是功能」。这是州级监管对 AI 深度伪造首次成规模的法律行动，对生成式 AI 的内容责任边界具有判例意义。

title: Amazon Nearing $7.5 Billion Purchase of Decart
raw_excerpt: Amazon is reportedly nearing a $7.5 billion deal to buy Decart, a three-year-old AI startup.
summary: 据 The Information 报道，亚马逊正接近以 75 亿美元收购成立仅三年的 AI 初创公司 Decart。若成交，这将是 AI 领域规模最大的并购之一，也延续了云厂商通过收购补齐模型与推理能力的路径。对判断 AI 一级市场估值与巨头整合节奏而言，这是一条高信息量的交易信号，值得持续跟踪后续确认。

title: A legendary philosopher isn’t buying Anthropic’s consciousness argument
raw_excerpt: This story originally appeared in The Algorithm, our weekly newsletter on AI. To get stories like this in your inbox first, sign up here . Before going public last week, Anthropic named the possibility that AI could be conscious or sentient as a risk factor for anyone investing. Given “the way we approach model sentience and moral status,” Anthropic wrote—which is to say it takes the possibility more seriously than any other AI company—it might adopt more rules and restrictions than its competitors to make sure its AI models are treated well. Anthropic counts a number of respected philosophers in its camp, and the company’s rationale goes something like this: Today’s AI might not be conscious, though we can’t know for sure; the chances of sentience go up as AI gets more capable; and that means we should be preparing for a near future in which AI systems have “moral significance,” meaning their consciousness makes it important they are protected from harm. This thinking isn’t all that fringe. According to one recent poll , 33% of the US public believes AI systems will definitely or probably develop consciousness eventually, and 7% say they already have. In a 2020 survey of 1,092 philosophers, 39% said some future AI systems will be conscious (for comparison, the philosophers were less confident about worms or flies being conscious). But last week, Anthropic’s openness to the consciousness question came under fire from a rather inconvenient source: one of the philosophers who …
summary: MIT 科技评论报道，Anthropic 在上市前将「AI 可能具备意识或感知」列为投资风险因素，因其对模型感知与道德地位的认真态度可能带来额外限制；但一位知名哲学家并不认同其论证。这揭示了前沿实验室在商业与伦理之间的真实张力，也把「模型福利」这一此前边缘的话题推到了 IPO 披露文件的正式语境中。
